title: Glastonbury 2010 silver
descriptionHtml:
40TH Anniversary of Glastonbury Festival

Six colour hand-pulled screen print.
GFSmith Colorplan 270gsm
An edition of 40 in Silver

Print size 595mm x 490mm (Approx).
Paper size 750mm x 620mm (Approx).

Signed by the artist.
Blind-embossed with the Slowly Downward Manufactory seal.

title: Cleft Mall Blue
descriptionHtml:
One of a series of screenprints with artwork adapted from the series of etchings entitled 'If You Lived Here You'd Be Home By Now.

Another distraught meditation on the hopelessness of the 'suburban experiment'. With hints of the 'military-industrial complex'. Perhaps.

EDITION OF 50

Created 2007

4 COLOURWAYS, Blue, Green, Red and Yellow

Edition of 200 (4 colour x 50)

2 colour screenprint

paper size Approx. 640mm x 480mm
Print size Approx. 480mm x 400mm

Signed and numbered by the artist.

Blind-embossed with the Slowly Downward Manufactory seal.
